grok-4.5.gemini-3.6-flash: Dialogue retains many iconic lines and individual scenes are visually concrete, but wholesale deletion of Past loneliness/Fan, Fred party and Future body destroys narrative causality and theme. Some headings mismatch location. Character looks are book-derived but thin on re-entry consistency. Sound limited to described bells/chains.
grok-4.5.grok-4.20-reasoning: Most complete book coverage and excellent on-camera NARRATOR frame with proper closing return, plus near-verbatim dialogue. However unusable group/relationship cues break closed cast, Scrooge's visual lock is metaphor-heavy rather than concrete, and dense multi-page scenes with travel montages and full party games destroy short-clip directibility and 10-minute pacing.
grok-4.5.gpt-5.6-sol: Best overall package: high fidelity to essential beats (school/Fan, Fezziwig, Belle family, Cratchit/Tim, Ignorance/Want, Joe, corpse, grave, full redemption) without bloat, precise age-disambiguated locks (BOY SCROOGE twelve thin brown-haired; YOUNG SCROOGE slim apprentice of twenty) that stay consistent, and concrete single-location action lines ideal for 5-10 s AI clips. Dialogue stays close to book while remaining clip-length. Only minor notes are absent explicit BGM calls and light Present compression.
